_about: Labeled retrieval eval for recall. Each item is a realistic natural-language query; `gold` lists the session-id prefixes (8 hex) that count as relevant answers. NOT REPRODUCIBLE BY OUTSIDERS: the gold ids refer to the original author's local, private transcript corpus, which is not published — run this fixture against your own index and every query scores zero, by construction. To evaluate on your corpus, replace `queries` with your own queries and gold session ids (`recall "<topic>" --pretty` shows the ids). Method, limitations, and how to do that: docs/embedding-models.md. Single annotator, paraphrased to favor semantic over lexical recall.
